name: Kirsten Renner
biography: Kirsten is the Talent Engagement Lead at Accenture Federal. She joined AFS through the acquisition of Novetta, after serving there as Director of Recruiting for 6 years. Her career started in IT building and running helpdesks, and she later moved into Technical Recruiting. She is best known in the community for both her role in the Car Hacking Village and her efforts as a speaker and volunteer across multiple events throughout the year. Kirsten offers over 20 years in technology services space and 15 in the hacker community and conference scene.
